description: A group of astronauts travels through a wormhole near Saturn to search for a new habitable planet for humanity. The story explores space travel, time dilation, love, sacrifice, and humanity's survival.
A skilled thief enters people's dreams to steal secrets from their subconscious. He is given a difficult mission to plant an idea inside someone's mind while dealing with his own memories and guilt.
A computer programmer discovers that reality is actually a simulated world controlled by intelligent machines. He joins a rebellion and learns to manipulate the artificial reality around him.
Batman faces the Joker, a criminal mastermind who creates chaos across Gotham City. The story explores justice, morality, sacrifice, and the conflict between order and anarchy.
After a devastating defeat against Thanos, the remaining Avengers attempt to reverse the destruction and bring back their fallen friends. The heroes face time travel, sacrifice, and one final battle.

A wealthy weapons manufacturer is captured by terrorists and builds an advanced armored suit to escape. After returning home, he transforms his technology into a superhero identity and fights dangerous enemies.

A group of unlikely criminals from across the galaxy must work together to protect a mysterious powerful artifact from a dangerous warlord. The film combines space adventure, comedy, friendship, and action.
An astronaut is accidentally left behind on Mars after his crew evacuates during an emergency. Using science, engineering, and determination, he tries to survive while NASA works on a rescue mission.
Two astronauts become stranded in space after debris destroys their spacecraft. They must navigate dangerous conditions and limited oxygen while trying to reach safety.

A linguist is recruited to communicate with mysterious extraterrestrial visitors who have arrived on Earth. As she learns their language, she discovers that their perception of time challenges human understanding.

A futuristic police officer discovers a secret that could change the relationship between humans and artificial beings. His investigation leads him to a former blade runner and reveals hidden truths about identity and humanity.

A young programmer is invited to a secluded research facility to evaluate an advanced artificial intelligence housed in a humanoid robot. The experiment becomes a psychological battle involving consciousness, manipulation, and control.
Two rival magicians become obsessed with creating the ultimate illusion. Their competition escalates into deception, sacrifice, and dangerous experiments as each tries to outperform the other.

A U.S. marshal investigates the disappearance of a patient from an isolated psychiatric hospital. As the investigation continues, disturbing clues make him question the island, the patients, and his own memories.

Two detectives investigate a series of disturbing murders connected to the seven deadly sins. Their investigation takes them into the mind of a calculated serial killer and leads to a dark confrontation.

A man's wife mysteriously disappears on their wedding anniversary, making him the center of a media investigation. As secrets about their marriage emerge, the truth becomes increasingly difficult to determine.
A banker is sentenced to life in prison for a crime he claims he did not commit. Over many years, he develops friendships and quietly maintains hope while finding ways to survive prison life.
A kind-hearted man with a simple outlook on life experiences several major historical events in America. His journey includes friendship, love, war, family, and unexpected success.
A struggling salesman becomes homeless while raising his young son. Despite financial hardship and repeated setbacks, he pursues an unpaid internship in hopes of building a better future.

A young jazz drummer enters an elite music conservatory and encounters an extremely demanding instructor. His ambition to become an exceptional musician pushes him toward intense practice, competition, and psychological pressure.

An aspiring actress and a passionate jazz musician fall in love while pursuing their creative dreams in Los Angeles. Their relationship is tested by ambition, career opportunities, and difficult choices.
Three friends travel to Las Vegas for a bachelor party and wake up with no memory of the previous night. They must retrace their steps and find their missing friend before the wedding.

Two high school friends attempt to attend a party and impress their classmates before graduation. Their plans quickly become chaotic as they deal with alcohol, police, friendship, and embarrassing situations.
A retired assassin is pulled back into the criminal underworld after a violent attack destroys the peaceful life he built. He uses his extraordinary combat skills to pursue those responsible.

In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a rebellious woman escapes from a tyrannical ruler with a group of enslaved women. She joins forces with a mysterious drifter in an intense high-speed battle for freedom.

A poor family gradually finds ways to become employed by a wealthy household. Their lives become deeply connected, revealing sharp differences between social classes and leading to unexpected consequences.

A Harvard student creates a revolutionary social networking website that grows into a global technology company. The story follows the relationships, lawsuits, ambition, and conflicts surrounding its creation.

A baseball general manager with limited resources uses statistical analysis to build a competitive team. He challenges traditional scouting methods and faces resistance while trying to change how players are evaluated.
A hotel concierge and his young lobby boy become involved in a mysterious inheritance dispute. Their adventure includes friendship, murder, stolen artwork, war, and eccentric characters.

A lonely writer develops an unusual romantic relationship with an advanced artificial intelligence operating system. Their relationship explores loneliness, intimacy, technology, consciousness, and human connection.
